messages.subject: Re: [knitr] externalization
parts:
Thanks! I should read more carefully next time!

I've written two little functions, .wordpress.url and .flickr.url that work with those platforms in the same way that .image.url works with imgur.  They require you set a few more options than imgur does to handle the authentication, but in case Yuhui (or others) are interested, you can see them here: https://github.com/cboettig/socialR/blob/master/R/custom_knit.R

They use the Rflickr & RWordPress packages to upload to those sites. 

Carl
